slot_bias.interpretation_limit: Observational diagnostics on original slots only. Ready/selection rates are confounded by arrival, burst and workload size. Identical-feature choices condition on equal six-feature observations in the selected group. Unique-shortest rates exclude single-ready states. Events are dependent; these are descriptive counts, not significance tests or a causal bias estimate.

dataset_role: Phase 5 model-selection validation; not final test
workload_id_convention: Zero-based index in original Phase 5 validation collection
limitations: Model-selection validation data; not an unbiased final-test estimate.
One checkpoint, one fixed workload collection, zero context-switch overhead.
Slot analysis is observational and cannot establish a causal slot effect.
Percentage gaps with zero SRTF waiting are null unless both waits are zero.
